content:
I have completed the research on the 6 requested YouTube channels. Here are the detailed statistics and insights gathered using a combination of direct YouTube URL fetching and extensive web searches (including SocialBlade references where available).

### 1. 20 Minute Professor (@20MinProfessor)
- **Channel display name:** 20 Minute Professor
- **Subscriber count:** Exact number hidden/unavailable; estimated to be in the high tens of thousands based on viewership and growth.
- **Total videos published:** Estimated to be a very small library (4-10 core long-form videos).
- **Date of most recent upload:** Active as of mid-2026 (recent upload in July 2026).
- **Most popular video:** "The Entire History of Drugs in 23 Minutes" (over 600,000 views).
- **Average views on recent uploads:** Exceptionally high; ranging from 100K to 600K+.
- **Sub-niche:** High-level educational summaries (History, Psychology, Human Biology, Science).
- **Production style:** Long-form explainer content utilizing animation, graphics, and concise structuring.
- **Upload frequency:** Sporadic/Monthly (focuses on high-effort long-form content).
- **Channel age:** Relatively new (earliest prominent hits from early 2026).

### 2. Unknown Frequencies (@unknownfrequencies-tv)
- **Channel display name:** Unknown Frequencies
- **Subscriber count:** 51.8K subscribers.
- **Total videos published:** Frequent uploads (estimated dozens).
- **Date of most recent upload:** Active.
- **Most popular video:** "Your Life as Every German Army Rank in WW2" (~985,000 views) / "The ENTIRE Story of The Odyssey Explained" (~978,000 views).
- **Average views on recent uploads:** Varies from 10K to several hundred thousand.
- **Sub-niche:** Military history (WW1, WW2, Vietnam), historical POV storytelling, and epic literature.
- **Production style:** "POV" storytelling format. Explicitly utilizes AI tools for voiceovers and image generation, combined with human scriptwriting.
- **Upload frequency:** Frequent (likely weekly).
- **Channel age:** Estimated to be 1-2 years old based on back catalog.

### 3. someunfilteredguy (@someunfilteredguy)
- **Channel display name:** someunfilteredguy
- **Subscriber count:** ~142,000 subscribers.
- **Total videos published:** 7 videos.
- **Date of most recent upload:** Active (experiencing rapid viral growth recently).
- **Most popular video:** "How to Learn Anything Faster Than Everyone" (~1.2 million views).
- **Average views on recent uploads:** ~400K+ per video (total channel views >3 million on just 7 videos).
- **Sub-niche:** Self-improvement, Productivity, Life advice.
- **Production style:** Faceless and highly minimalist. Uses a black background with white stick-figure drawings and direct, "no-fluff" narration.
- **Upload frequency:** Sporadic/Low frequency (relies on evergreen virality).
- **Channel age:** Very new, explosive recent growth.

### 4. Good Enough (@GoodEnoughAnimation)
- **Channel display name:** Good Enough
- **Subscriber count:** ~1.53 million subscribers.
- **Total videos published:** 222 videos.
- **Date of most recent upload:** Highly active.
- **Most popular video:** "The Worst Punishments in Human History" (~16 million views).
- **Average views on recent uploads:** Consistently in the hundreds of thousands to millions.
- **Sub-niche:** Animated documentaries, history, mysteries (UFOs, bizarre phenomena), survival tips.
- **Production style:** Distinct commentary-style animation/animated video essays. High production value.
- **Upload frequency:** Frequent (weekly to biweekly).
- **Channel age:** Well-established, multi-year history.

### 5. easy, actually (@easyactually)
- **Channel display name:** easy, actually
- **Subscriber count:** ~1.13 million subscribers.
- **Total videos published:** 24 videos.
- **Date of most recent upload:** Active.
- **Most popular video:** "becoming smart is easy, actually" (~9.5 million views).
- **Average views on recent uploads:** Very high, averaging over 1 million views per video (33.9 million channel views across 24 videos).
- **Sub-niche:** Personal development, productivity, psychological life advice.
- **Production style:** Faceless, minimalist storytelling with simple, striking visual illustrations. Titles follow a strict "[Topic] is easy, actually" formula.
- **Upload frequency:** Monthly or less (Quality over quantity).
- **Channel age:** Well-established but low volume.

### 6. Explaineur (@Explaineur)
- **Channel display name:** Explaineur
- **Subscriber count:** 28.2K subscribers.
- **Total videos published:** Dozens (exact count unspecified in scraped stats).
- **Date of most recent upload:** Active.
- **Most popular video:** "Every Small Habit That Fixes Big Problems Explained" (~566,000 views).
- **Average views on recent uploads:** Ranges between 10K to 100K (around 2 million total channel views).
- **Sub-niche:** Self-improvement, behavioral psychology, micro-habits, life hacks.
- **Production style:** Edutainment utilizing an "Every [Topic] Explained" format; features breakdowns and actionable advice.
- **Upload frequency:** Regular (Weekly/Bi-weekly).
- **Channel age:** Newer channel (gaining traction throughout 2026).
